table.retrieve:
SELECT
	documentcode=d.documentcode,
	customercategory=(select name from customercategory where custcatcode=:ai_custcatcode),
	grouptype=' Sale',
	
	D.invdate,
	patientregno=(select  RegNo from patient P where P.patientCode=D.patientcode),
	patientname=(select name from patient P where  P.patientcode=D.patientcode),
	patientward=(select ward from patient P where  P.patientcode=D.patientcode),
	customer=(Select A.name from accounts A where A.acccode=D.custcode),
	saleinvcode=D.saleinvcode,
	saleamont=D.saleamount,
	/*salestax=(case D.taxamount when 0 then '-' else D.taxamount end),*/
	salestax= D.taxamount,
	Totalamount=D.saleamount + D.taxamount

From Customer,

(SELECT
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SL.SaleInvCode))),
	invdate=max(SL.originaldate),
	saleinvcode=SL.saleinvcode,
	custcode=SL.custcode,
	patientcode=SL.patientcode,
	patientcustcode=(select custcode from patient P where  P.patientcode=SL.patientcode),
	
	
	saleamount=Round(
							SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) + 
							SL.misccharges + SL.salestax - SL.flatdisc, 0),
  
taxamount=Round(SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
							SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
								(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
							ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
							(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
							SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)

FROM saleledger SL, saledetail SD
WHERE   
			
			SL.originaldate Between:ar_Sdate AND :ar_Ldate AND
			SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode
GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,
			SL.patientcode,
			 SL.CustCode,
			SL.discperc,
			SL.misccharges,
			SL.salestax,
			SL.flatdisc,
			SL.invgstperc1) D


WHERE  customer.custcatcode=:ai_custcatcode and
			customer.custcode=D.custcode

union all

SELECT 
	D.documentcode,
	customercategory=(select name from customercategory where custcatcode=:ai_custcatcode),
	grouptype='Less Return',
	
	D.invdate,
	patientregno=(select  RegNo from patient P where P.patientCode=D.patientcode),
	patientname=(select name from patient P where  P.patientcode=D.patientcode),
	patientward=(select ward from patient P where  P.patientcode=D.patientcode),
	customer=(Select A.name from accounts A where A.acccode=D.custcode),
	srinvcode=D.srinvcode,
	saleamont=D.saleamount,
	salestax=D.taxamount,
	Totalamount=D.saleamount + D.taxamount

From Customer,

(SELECT
	documentcode = 'SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SL.SRInvCode))),
	invdate=max(SL.originaldate),
	srinvcode=SL.srinvcode,
	custcode=SL.custcode,
	patientcode=SL.patientcode,
	patientcustcode=(select custcode from patient P where  P.patientcode=SL.patientcode),
	
	
	saleamount=Round(
							SUM((SD.looseqty*SD.saleprice ) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) + 
							SL.misccharges + SL.salestax - SL.flatdisc, 0),
  
taxamount=Round(SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
							SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice ) *
								(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
							ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
							(SD.saleprice )) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
							SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)

FROM srledger SL, srdetail SD
WHERE   
			
			SL.originaldate Between:ar_Sdate AND :ar_Ldate AND
			SL.srinvcode = SD.srinvcode
GROUP BY SL.srinvcode,
			SL.patientcode,
			 SL.CustCode,
			SL.discperc,
			SL.misccharges,
			SL.salestax,
			SL.flatdisc,
			SL.invgstperc1) D


WHERE  customer.custcatcode=:ai_custcatcode and
			customer.custcode=D.custcode
ORDER By
			grouptype,
			saleinvcode

objects.expression: sum(if( grouptype =' Sale', totalamount, 0) for all)

objects.name: compute_12

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: sum(if( grouptype =' Sale', totalamount, 0) for all) - 1

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: (sum(if( grouptype =' Sale', totalamount, 0) for all) - sum(if( grouptype <>' Sale', totalamount, 0) for all))* ad_discperc *0.01

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: (sum(if( grouptype =' Sale', totalamount, 0) for all) - sum(if( grouptype <>' Sale', totalamount, 0) for all))* (1 - ad_discperc *0.01)
